item.title: Hitozuma Kyoushi wa Moto Mahou Shoujo ~Oshiego no Boku ga Otona no Onna o Netori Otosu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mahoutsukai Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-06-20
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (100 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 人妻教師は元魔法少女 ～教え子の僕がオトナの女を寝取り堕とす～
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Kyoushi wa Moto Mahou Shoujo Oshiego no Boku ga Otona no Onna o Netori Otosu

别名

  • Hitozumakyoushi wa Moto Mahoshoujo

あらすじ

Who knew? Wife, mother and schoolteacher Nanako Hikawa used to be a crime-fighting magical girl!

Back in her youth she cast spells and saved worlds as Sapphire of bishoujo team “Justice Pirates”.

15 years after they destroyed the stronghold of an evil organization, the Mad Professor’s grandchild Tsutomu discovers that his teacher was a member of this group. Using the devices that he found in his grandfather’s warehouse, he plans to make Nanako his sex slave.

  • 日本語名: 人妻は元魔法少女 ～下級戦闘員だった俺が痴漢を繰り返し寝取り落とす～
  • 英語名: Hitozuma wa Moto Mahou Shoujo Kakyuu Sentouin Datta Ore ga Chikan o Kurikaeshi Netori Otosu

あらすじ

Who know!? Happily married housewife Yuki Sonozaki used to be a crime-fighting magical girl!

Back in her youth she cast spells and saved worlds as Emerald of bishoujo team “Justice Pirates”.

15 years after they destroyed the stronghold of an evil organization, the Mad Professor’s minions have tracked each girl down for one purpose: sexual revenge!
